title: [DEPLOY-QUEUE][READY] Control Center post-canary read-only reconciliation
body:
## Queue contract

- **source_repository:** `rozkalnsandris/rozkalns-control-center`
- **exact_git_sha_or_waiting_merge:** `f9b900a884bffda993197fc7fa9223c886e11a90`
- **source_pr_or_issue_if_applicable:** Control Center #491 diagnostic-preserving source fix merged; synthetic queue fixture only
- **target_alias:** `control-center-merge-postcanary-reconcile`
- **execution_location_class:** `github-actions-readonly`
- **repository_entrypoint:** `.github/workflows/phase3-merge-postcanary-readonly-reconcile.yml` fixed reviewed selector
- **expected_baseline_when_observable:** resolve the consumed Merge canary audit row and exact target evidence before any future owner trigger
- **read_only_preflight:** exact repository identity, merged/reachable SHA, exact-SHA CI, workflow blob, trigger contract and D1 SELECT-only contract
- **verification_and_reconciliation:** P9 emits DRY_RUN_READY only and all workflow/DB/Worker/Cloudflare/GitHub mutation flags remain false
- **allowed_mutation_categories_and_limits:** one future read-only reconciliation run; zero mutation during P9
- **explicit_exclusions:** GitHub merge/decision; D1 write/migration/apply; Worker deploy; Cloudflare config; app credentials/permissions; host/runtime
- **dependencies_if_any:** reviewed workflow blob, ops-workflows target identity, owner-comment trigger contract, D1 SELECT-only zero-write contract
- **deploy_class_and_extra_owner_gate_requirement:** `STRICT_LIVE_AUTH_REQUIRED`; posting the owner trigger remains separately authorized and is prohibited during P9

## Evidence

Synthetic source-only queue fixture. It does not create a real READY issue, LIVE-AUTH, owner trigger comment, workflow run, D1 request, deploy, or host/runtime mutation.
